title: Cleaned survey row
description: One row of data/processed/survey_clean.csv, rebuilt locally by `make data` from data/raw/*.xlsx (sheet 'Survey Data'). ROW-LEVEL: never committed, never uploaded. v0 by narrative from the case column list; data agent owns it from v1 and must document the raw->clean label mapping in agents/data/. Likert items are 1-5, higher = more agreement/satisfaction (v0 assumption; data agent confirms scale per item). Unknown labels become null and are listed in `flags`; they never crash the pipeline. Multi-value fields are ';'-joined in CSV.

language.description: 'en' or 'es' (raw: language). Anything else: raw value lowercased + flag.

roles.description: Raw: role (multi-select). Canonical labels, sorted, ';'-joined, trailing ';' and whitespace stripped. '' = none given.

training_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null if missing (3 in the provided file).

county.description: Canonical county, e.g. 'Anne Arundel', "Prince George's", 'Montgomery'. Out-of-state keeps state, e.g. 'Fairfax (VA)'. Mapping table in agents/data/.

post_identify_crisis.description: Post: I can identify signs of a crisis.

post_know_when_to_use.description: Post: I know when to use 988.

pre_identify_crisis.description: RETROSPECTIVE 'before training' rating, asked after training (biased; always caveat).

comment_valuable.description: Free text: most valuable. Whitespace-normalized, otherwise verbatim.
